verses.pali: … “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye surāmerayamajjappamādaṭṭhānā apaṭiviratā …pe….
verses.english: “… the sentient beings who refrain from beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants, are few, while those who don’t refrain are many. …”
